name: code_index
description: Index OADSON's own codebase for semantic search, or search it. Use 'search' when asked to find where something is implemented, how a feature works, or to locate relevant code before making a change. Use 'index' to (re)build the index after code changes. Use 'status' to check what's currently indexed.

action.description: 'index' to (re)build the embedding index, 'search' to semantically search indexed code, 'status' to see counts.

project.description: Project name to scope this to. Defaults to 'oadson' if omitted.

root.description: Directory to index (action='index' only). Defaults to the current working directory of the running OADSON process — i.e. its own deployed codebase.

query.description: Natural-language search query (action='search' only), e.g. 'where is the Gmail token refresh logic'.

limit.description: Max search results to return. Defaults to 5.
